card.name: Viral and virologic terms in HIV/HBV labels
card.fires_on: The word viral, or the start of virus-related words like Viro-logic and Vir-al, in HIV or hepatitis B label text, before resistance, load or failure. It also fires weakly on 'the' or a hyphen in lists and compounds in general web text.

modes.label: Viral before load or resistance
modes.description: The word viral or its pieces, right before load, resistance or failure in antiviral labels.
modes.example: Lower exposures of rilpivirine were observed during pregnancy, therefore<< viral>> load should be monitored closely.

modes.label: Inside virologic words
modes.description: Partway through virologic or viral in section headings about resistance or failure.
modes.example: 5.7 Risk of HIV-1 Viro<<logic>> Failure in Patients with HBV/HIV

modes.label: General web text linking words
modes.description: A small word such as the or a hyphen in history or aircraft prose.
modes.example: losing ground to the Hungarians in the Balkans and<< the>> Seljuk Turks in Anatolia.

card.plain: It lights up on the word viral and related virus words in HIV and hepatitis B drug labels.
